notes.title: Major User Feedback
notes.notes:
-Combat has been overhauled to be more intuitive. User input is now recognized faster. Killing enemies is much easier.
-Have full control over all your graphics settings, including brightness, Field of View, and Render Distance
-Colliders have been massively restructured to avoid players getting stuck on doors and stairs

Major thanks to all user feedback. This game is my first big project as a developer, and it's been a fantastic learning opportunity for me. I take all your feedback and  learn from it as best as I can, so my next title will be a huge improvement. Thanks always for your support ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
-Fixed bug where video tapes were not appearing until very late in the level
-Fixed speed change when players held crouch and sprint at the same  time

notes.title: Bug fixes/user feedback improvements
notes.notes:
Bug fixes!
-Med kit achievement tracks now
-Settings menu and pause menu cannot be enabled at the same time
-Cursor is locked to one screen for users with multiple screens
-Fast travel page is now enabled for all users by default
-Enemies can no longer attack when NPC dialogs are active
-Devil's pit is now marked on the mini map
